user.title: WG Easy
user.description: Set up the WG Easy integration. Choose "auto" to let the integration detect whether your wg-easy server speaks the v14 (password) or v15 (API token) API, or pick one explicitly and provide only the matching credential.

data_description.token: v15 only. The Bearer Password set under Admin Panel → General → Metrics in the wg-easy web UI (used to protect the metrics endpoint). Leave empty if your server is v14.
data_description.password: v14 only. The same password you use to log in to the wg-easy web UI (set via the PASSWORD/PASSWORD_HASH environment variable on the wg-easy container). Leave empty if your server is v15.

data_description.token: v15 only. The Bearer Password set under Admin Panel → General → Metrics in the wg-easy web UI (used to protect the metrics endpoint). Leave empty if your server is v14.
data_description.password: v14 only. The same password you use to log in to the wg-easy web UI (set via the PASSWORD/PASSWORD_HASH environment variable on the wg-easy container). Leave empty if your server is v15.
